titleEn: How Long Does a Vancouver Kitchen Renovation Take? A Complete 2026 Timeline
titleZh: 温哥华厨房装修需要多久？2026完整时间线
contentEn:
A typical full kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver takes 12 to 20 weeks from demolition to final inspection. This guide breaks down every phase so you can plan around your family's schedule and set realistic expectations with your contractor.

Note: This timeline covers a full kitchen renovation, not a cosmetic refresh. A repaint and new hardware can take 2-3 weeks. A full gut and redesign starts at 3 months.

Phase 1: Design and Permits (Weeks 1-6)

Weeks 1-2: Initial Design. Your contractor and designer measure the existing space, document the current layout, and discuss your goals. Do you want a chef-style island? Better workflow between sink and stove? Open plan to the dining area? This stage produces a preliminary layout and material selections.

What affects timeline: If you are doing structural work - removing a load-bearing wall, moving drainage, or adding a window - design takes longer because an engineer must sign off.

Weeks 3-4: Material Selections. Cabinetry is the longest-lead item. Custom cabinets from Vancouver-area shops typically require 6-10 weeks from deposit to delivery. If you are choosing imported hardware or specialty tile, add 2-4 weeks for shipping.

Pro tip: Finalize cabinet selection before demo begins. Delays here are the single biggest cause of project overruns.

Weeks 5-6: Permit Application (if required). In Vancouver, a building permit is required when you move plumbing, alter structural elements, or change the layout. Richmond, Burnaby, and Surrey have similar thresholds. Permit review in Metro Vancouver typically takes 4-6 weeks for kitchen-only projects, but if structural work is involved, budget 8-12 weeks.

What is exempt: Replacing appliances, refacing cabinets, laying new flooring, and cosmetic changes generally do not require a permit.

Phase 2: Demolition (Days 1-5)

Demo typically runs Monday through Friday. The crew protects adjacent rooms with plastic sheeting, disconnects plumbing and electrical, and removes all materials to be replaced.

What affects timeline: If your home has asbestos (common in homes built before 1990), a separate abatement company must test and remediate before demo can proceed. This adds 2-4 weeks.

Noise note: Vancouver bylaws restrict construction noise to weekdays between 7:30 AM and 8:00 PM. Saturday work is permitted in most municipalities with time restrictions.

Phase 3: Rough-In (Weeks 3-5 of construction)

This is the hidden phase - work happening inside walls and under floors. It includes: Electrical (new circuit runs for outlets, under-cabinet lighting, and appliance circuits, panel upgrades if required), Plumbing (moving drain lines, supply pipes, and gas lines if applicable), HVAC (any ductwork changes or additions), and Insulation and vapour barriers required before drywall.

This phase ends with a rough-in inspection where the city inspector reviews the work before it is covered up.

Phase 4: Cabinet and Countertop Installation (Weeks 6-10)

Cabinet delivery usually happens in week 6 or 7. Installation itself takes 3-5 days for a standard kitchen. Cabinet installation must be complete before countertop templating.

Countertops: Laminate takes 1-2 weeks from template to install. Quartz takes 2-3 weeks from template to install. Natural stone (granite, marble) takes 3-5 weeks including template, fabrication, and install.

Backsplash: Once countertops are in, the tile setter comes in. Standard subway tile backsplash takes 2-4 days. More complex patterns (herringbone, mosaic, large-format) take 4-7 days.

Phase 5: Final Electrical, Painting, and Flooring (Weeks 10-14)

Electrical trim: Outlets, switches, light fixtures, and under-cabinet lighting installed. Painting: Two coats of paint, including primer on new drywall, plus drying time between coats. Typically 3-4 days of work spread over a week. Flooring: Vinyl plank or tile installation. Vinyl plank is faster (1-2 days); tile requires grouting and sealing time.

Phase 6: Final Inspection and Punch List (Weeks 14-18)

When all work is complete, your contractor schedules the final building inspection. Any deficiencies noted by the inspector are addressed in the punch list - typically small items that do not require re-inspection. After inspection passes, you receive a certificate of final inspection (keep for records and resale), operational manuals for appliances and fixtures, and contractor warranty documentation.

Timeline Summary: Design and permit 6-12 weeks. Demolition 1 week. Rough-in 3-5 weeks. Cabinet and countertop install 4-7 weeks. Final finishes 3-5 weeks. Final inspection 1-2 weeks. Total 12-20 weeks.

How to Keep Your Project on Schedule: 1. Finalize selections before demo. Cabinets and countertops have the longest lead times. 2. Get your permit early. Apply during the design phase, not after. 3. Check for asbestos if your home is pre-1990. Budget remediation time. 4. Choose your contractor based on their schedule clarity, not just price. A contractor who communicates timeline risks clearly upfront will outperform one who underestimates. 5. Reserve 15-20% of your budget as contingency. Hidden conditions behind walls - rot, outdated wiring, non-compliant plumbing - are common in Vancouver older housing stock.

What This Means for Your Reno Stars Project: At Reno Stars, every full kitchen renovation includes a detailed schedule review before work begins. We assign a single project manager who is your point of contact throughout. We handle permit applications, coordinate city inspections, and provide written milestone sign-offs so you always know where your project stands. To get a preliminary timeline for your kitchen, contact us with your address and a brief description of the work you are considering.
contentZh:
大温哥华地区全面厨房装修——更换橱柜、台面、挡板、地面和电器——从拆除到最终验收通常需要12到20周。本指南详细分解每个阶段，帮助您规划家庭时间安排，对装修时间有现实预期。

注意：本时间线涵盖全面厨房装修，不适用于仅更换硬件等轻度翻新。单纯刷新油漆和新把手通常只需2-3周。完全拆改设计至少需要3个月。

第一阶段：设计与许可（装修前第1-6周）

第1-2周：初步设计。您的承包商和设计师测量现有空间，记录当前布局，并讨论您的需求。您想要开放式岛台？水槽和炉灶之间更好的操作动线？还是与餐厅打通？此阶段产出初步平面布局和材料选择清单。

影响进度的因素：如果您要进行结构改造——拆除承重墙、移动排水管或增设窗户——设计阶段会延长，因为需要工程师签字确认。

第3-4周：材料选定。橱柜是采购周期最长的项目。温哥华地区定制橱柜从付款到交货通常需要6-10周，如果您选择进口五金件或特殊瓷砖，另加2-4周运输时间。

专业建议：在拆除前敲定橱柜选择方案。橱柜延迟是导致装修超期最常见的原因。

第5-6周：申请许可证（如需要）。在温哥华，移动管道、改造结构或改变布局需要申请建筑许可证。列治文、本拿比和素里的要求类似。大温哥华地区厨房项目的许可证审核通常需要4-6周；如果涉及结构工程，则需8-12周。

豁免项目：更换电器、柜门贴面、铺设新地板和 cosmetic 装修通常无需许可证。

第二阶段：拆除（第1-5天）

拆除通常在周一至周五进行。施工人员用塑料布保护相邻房间，断开管道和电路，移除所有需要更换的材料。

影响进度的因素：如果您的房屋有石棉（1990年前建造的房屋常见），则需要单独的治理公司先检测和治理，拆除才能开始。这会增加2-4周时间。

噪音提示：温哥华附例规定，施工噪音仅限工作日上午7:30至晚上8:00。大多数城市允许周六施工但有时间限制。

第三阶段：隐蔽工程（施工第3-5周）

这是看不见的阶段——工作发生在墙壁内部和地板下方。包括：电路（新增插座，暗装照明和电器电路的线路，必要时升级配电箱）、管道（移动排水管、供水管和燃气管道如适用）、暖通（任何管道改动或新增）、保温和防潮层（在安装石膏板前必须完成）。

此阶段以隐蔽工程验收结束——市政检查员在工程封板前检查。

第四阶段：橱柜与台面安装（第6-10周）

橱柜通常在第6或第7周到场。标准厨房安装需要3-5天。橱柜安装完成后才能进行台面测量。

台面材料周期：层压板（Formica）从测量到安装1-2周。石英石从测量到安装2-3周。天然石材（花岗岩、大理石）包括测量、加工和安装共3-5周。

挡板瓷砖：台面安装完毕后，瓷砖工进场。标准 subway 瓷砖挡板需要2-4天。更复杂的图案（人字纹、马赛克、大规格瓷砖）需要4-7天。

第五阶段：收尾电工、涂装和地面（第10-14周）

灯具安装：插座、开关、灯具和橱柜底灯安装。涂装：两遍面漆，包括新石膏板上的底漆，各遍之间需要干燥时间。通常3-4天工作，分布在一周内。地面铺设：乙烯基塑料地板或瓷砖。塑料地板较快（1-2天）；瓷砖需要灌浆和密封时间。

第六阶段：最终验收与整改（第14-18周）

所有工程完成后，您的承包商安排最终建筑检查。检查员在整改清单中指出的任何缺陷都将被处理——通常是不需要重新检查的小项目。验收通过后，您将收到：最终验收证书（请保留，用于将来转售）、电器和五金件的操作手册、承包商保修文件。

时间线汇总：设计与许可6-12周。拆除1周。隐蔽工程3-5周。橱柜与台面安装4-7周。收尾工程3-5周。最终验收1-2周。合计12-20周。

如何保持项目进度：1. 拆除前敲定所有材料方案。橱柜和台面采购周期最长。2. 尽早申请许可证。在设计阶段申请，不要等到开工后。3. 1990年前建造的房屋需检测石棉。将治理时间纳入计划。4. 选择能清晰说明时间表的承包商。能提前告知风险的承包商，比低价中标但预估不足的更可靠。5. 预留15-20%预算作为应急款。墙壁内部常见隐藏问题——腐烂、过期线路、不合规管道——在大温哥华老旧房源中很常见。

这对您的 Reno Stars 项目意味着什么：Reno Stars 承接的每一个全面厨房装修项目，在开工前都会提供详细的时间进度表审查。我们为每个项目配备专属项目经理，作为您整个装修过程的联系人。我们处理许可证申请，协调市政检查，并在每个节点提供书面确认，确保您随时了解项目进展。如需初步了解您厨房装修的时间安排，请联系我们，提供您的地址和装修计划简介。
